definitions.explanation: A written or printed representation of music using musical notation. Includes all forms from full orchestral scores to simple song sheets.

examples.japanese: {楽譜|がくふ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}ながら→見る：00283_miru⟧⟦ピアノ→ピアノ：01376_piano⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{弾|ひ}く→弾く：02444_hiku⟧。
examples.english: I play the piano while looking at the sheet music.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{曲|きょく}→曲：09881_kyoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{楽譜|がくふ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦ダウンロードした→ダウンロード：04725_daunroodo⟧。
examples.english: I downloaded the sheet music for this song.

examples.japanese: {楽譜|がくふ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{読|よ}めなくても→読む：00426_yomu⟧⟦{耳|みみ}→耳：01513_mimi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{覚|おぼ}えられる→覚える：00739_oboeru⟧。
examples.english: Even if you can't read sheet music, you can learn by ear.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {楽譜|がくふ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}む→読む：00426_yomu⟧: to read music
- {楽譜|がくふ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{読|よ}めない→読む：00426_yomu⟧: to be unable to read music — the usual way to say it, with the potential form
- {楽譜|がくふ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧: to write out music
- {楽譜|がくふ}⟦{台|だい}→台：13039_dai⟧: a music stand
- {楽譜|がくふ}⟦{売|う}り{場|ば}→売り場：01331_uriba⟧: the sheet music department of a shop

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{譜面|ふめん}→譜面：11103_fumen⟧: the same thing, but used more by working musicians and in band contexts; {楽譜|がくふ} is the neutral everyday word
- ⟦{五線譜|ごせんふ}→五線譜：15571_gosenfu⟧: staff notation specifically — the five-line staff itself
- {総譜|そうふ}: a full orchestral score, showing every part
- パート{譜|ふ}: a part, the single-instrument extract a player actually reads from

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{音符|おんぷ}→音符：06988_onpu⟧: a musical note
- ⟦{休符|きゅうふ}→休符：07538_kyuufu⟧: a rest
